'''HealthiDrive''' was a company that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Gaib]] and [[TK-0]], a pair of information brokers, rendezvoused with the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s led by [[Ordo Skirata]] on a freight terminal on Ralltiir aboard a HealthiDrive service vessel.<ref name="IC 501st" />
